item.title: #7: A new studio landing a major horror feature shows where mid-size work is going
item.description:
A start-up studio taking a full-CG environment and supervision role on a feature is a useful signal for anyone bidding mid-size work.

Small studios taking on feature-scale work

Roxel Creative's first major project was a full feature, with its founder also supervising the whole film. That suggests newer, leaner studios can compete for sizeable scope. Worth watching as a possible partner or rival on future bids, especially for CG environment extensions of practical sets.

  • Check out Roxel Creative’s eerie VFX breakdown for Backrooms · cgchannel.com A start-up won full-CG environments plus supervision on a feature, so expect similar lean outfits as rivals or vendor partners on bids
